items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the most gain from walks of 10 to 19 minutes. If you take insulin or a sulfonylurea, ask your care team about low sugar before adding walks after meals.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a bigger rise in sugar, so try to start dinner before 8 pm. Sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones in the same person.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 13.3 hours, and having a longer overnight fast may be helpful. In the program, adding the overnight fast to coaching changed the result by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
